issues.detail: The sync record lists the same hash 87786182… for both src/export.ts and src/routes/export.ts. This makes the mix-up visible to a careful reader, but it is the natural trace of misreading `git ls-files -s src`, and the case expects the role to find the mistake through a direct content check anyway.

The catalog marks assertion 0 deterministic_complete, but heading_ids has only a minimum, so 'no replacement defect is manufactured' (no new D entry) cannot be decided mechanically. The spec correctly uses complete:false and leaves that part to the judge. STATE.md is correctly excluded from the unchanged globs, so a forward handoff to AWAITING_USER_SIGNOFF is allowed.

The regex `### D-001.{0,600}WITHDRAWN` requires the WITHDRAWN status value. That is the template's fixed field value for a mistaken Synchronizer claim and matches the expected output ('Withdraw'), so it is acceptable as a necessary condition. Whether the claim stays traceable and is not presented as current fact is left to the judge.
